items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: And I did a thing with Billie Holiday that had a couple of nice spots there that I felt pretty good about — “Lady in Satin” album.

ctx.x: Well there’s less to worry about, right?

Yeah as a player. When you’re the leader you’ve got all these headaches and you’re worrying about the other guys showing up, and how much money you’re costing the record company, and if we go overtime I’ll never record with them again. And all kinds of things when you’re the leader you know. I don’t know. There was a record I did with Tony Bennett a long time ago. I had a couple of spots on it that I got into some kind of other frame of mind for a few bars. It was something about New York My Home Town or…
